jruby.about: JRuby 10.1.2.0 compiled to JavaScript by TeaVM 0.16.0 (the JS build, not wasm-gc), for the JRuby lesson

patch.about: the lesson build's source on top of base: git format-patch of one commit (local branch lesson-merged, 38898b4 in the builder's checkout), apply with git am; the result's tree is the one named here

jruby.changes: json gem 2.21.2 Java ext (require 'json'), jackson-core 2.18.2, lesson.Quakes, ZXing core 3.5.4, AtomicInteger/ConcurrentHashMap, TCharset aliases + isSupported, TCharConversionException
jruby.build: git clone https://github.com/Largo/jruby-teavm && git -C jruby-teavm checkout 730d53b && git -C jruby-teavm am <this repo>/tools/jruby-teavm-lesson.patch, then setup/fetch.sh (inputs, incl. jackson-core 2.18.2 and ZXing core 3.5.4 from Maven Central, SHA-256-checked) and ./build.sh (about 3 min on the Hetzner box, never on the 1-core Linode). Rebuilt that way on 2026-10-17: jruby.js bit-identical; stdlib.zip the same 1376 entries byte for byte, only its zip timestamps differ (so its pin is the build that shipped)
